evidence_note: Eigenstructure, SVD/PCA and their interpretation are covered; projections and the full regression/least-squares connection are split across adjacent lessons and not integrated here.

source_subtopic_title: Taylor expansion and linearisation; error propagation
evidence_note: First-order Taylor linearisation and derivative-based uncertainty propagation are now explained with a nonlinear radiation example; second-order effects and Monte Carlo comparison remain unworked.

evidence_note: Stock–flux ODEs and numerical integration are introduced; coupled-system stability and a full relaxation-to-equilibrium calculation remain limited.

source_subtopic_title: Finite differences, numerical integration, stability and time-stepping; floating-point error
evidence_note: Finite-difference/numerical integration and time-stepping limitations are covered; floating-point error and stability regions are not worked through.

source_subtopic_title: Optimisation: least squares, gradient descent, constrained optimisation concepts

source_subtopic_title: Conservation of mass, momentum, and energy; continuity equation; diffusion and advection equations
evidence_note: Mass/water conservation is applied to a control volume; momentum, continuity, diffusion and advection equations are not taught in this block.

evidence_note: Dimensional consistency and scaling are covered; Buckingham Pi derivation and named non-dimensional numbers are not demonstrated.

source_subtopic_title: Waves, radiation, and heat transfer: conduction, convection, radiation
evidence_note: Surface energy balance and thermal radiation are addressed; conduction/convection and wave propagation are only partial or absent.

evidence_note: Probability, uncertainty and dependence are introduced; a complete conditional-probability/Bayes/distribution worked example is not evidenced.
